name: Chau Doc fermented fish
summary: Mắm is fermented fish, the smell of Chợ Châu Đốc. Vietnam Tourism describes fish pickled with palm sugar, salt, chili, and garlic, stacked in the open, and calls the town the kingdom of pickled fish. The An Giang portal records two collective trademarks, đặc sản mắm Châu Đốc and đặc sản mắm thái Châu Đốc. Eat it with rice, or take a jar home.
origin: Châu Đốc. UBND phường Châu Đốc names mắm-making as a traditional trade and mắm Châu Đốc as a well-known specialty. The An Giang portal, 6 Dec 2023, says the workshops cluster at Núi Sam and the old Châu Phú A and make a market known across the country.
culture: The An Giang portal says mắm Châu Đốc has two collective trademarks: đặc sản mắm Châu Đốc and đặc sản mắm thái Châu Đốc. It also quotes a VietKings record from April 2022 for the number of southern mắm workshops in the city. Brand names in that article are makers, not a shortlist.
taste: VnExpress on 2 Oct 2019 says Châu Đốc mắm leans sweet and finishes salty, and that it goes with rice. You can taste it on the spot or carry it home.
howToEat: Vietnam Tourism’s charms chapter: walk the stacks in the market. The fish is pickled with palm sugar, salt, chili, and garlic. A recipe was not copied from that chapter.
The An Giang portal says visitors choose among mắm cá lóc, cá linh, cá trèn, cá sặc, and mắm thái. It says each stall posts a price. No figure was printed. Check on arrival.

VnExpress on 2 Oct 2019 lists mắm Thái, cá lóc, cá linh, ba khía, cá sặc, and cá trèn at Chợ Châu Đốc or the foot of Núi Sam, and printed a range from a few tens of thousands of dong to more than 100,000 VND a kilogram. The 26 Apr 2024 handbook names mắm from cá trèn, cá lóc, cá linh, and cá sọc. Cá sặc and cá sọc are both printed. Both lists stay.
Mắm cá mè vinh, on the An Giang portal, is the Tân Châu specialty. It is not the Châu Đốc jar.
where: Chợ Châu Đốc, and the foot of Núi Sam on the 2 Oct 2019 VnExpress list. The ward names the trade in phường Châu Đốc. A stall number was not printed. Check on arrival.
seoDescription: Mắm Châu Đốc is fermented fish at the market, with a separate mắm thái trademark. VnExpress and the province name different fish. Check on arrival for the price.
